messages.subject: shiny apps..io hosting
parts:
Good morning all,

I have been attempting to get a CAT up and running for my lab, but it is proving to be very difficult. I have spent quite some time troubleshooting code over the past few weeks and would like to publicly host an adaptive survey I made. When I "select all" and "run" my code through R the code launches my browser and it looks great! When I exit my web browser and return to R my viewer window opens and displays the survey, but it has all the default mirtCAT GUI settings. When I "publish" the survey I get an error and a failure to launch. Here is a summary of my problems:

1. The GUI in my viewer window is the mirtCAT default. 
2. Publishing a white screen with "An error has occurred" 

I have attached the log for my shinyapps.io if that will help, there is an error of "cannot change working directory" 

Any help would be greatly appreciated! I am new to R and mirtCAT and I could use some teaching in this area if anyone would be willing to help. I appreciate it!

Best,
Alec

parts:
﻿Thanks for looping back to this. We got a “beta” version to work with a visual summary graph at end. Right now we are trying to figure out a way to only administer items within the scale and meeting that scale’s termination criteria before proceeding with items on other scales. Of course we’d want to run simulations to determine the impact of this. We tried  customNextItem and saw the example with number of items but gave up. Here’s our beta version in case folx are interested. 

Diabetes Behavioral Health Screening
flourishscreener.shinyapps.io

Sent from my iPhone
